༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho bzhugs so//

bla ma dpal ldan he ru kaḥ /bde ba'i rdo rje la btud nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho bri| |nang sgrub drod tshad mthar phyin nas// gsang ba nyid du 'di ltar bsgrub// dang po sngon 'gro bsam gtan dbang*// rang mdun gyad dang seṅge'i khrir| |padma zla nyi mdzes pa'i steng*// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// rnam pa khyab bdag he ru kaḥ /mthing nag rin chen rus pa dang*// dar gyis brgyan cing rdor skyil bzhugs// rdo rje dril bu bsnol 'dzin pa'i// pang du rang 'dra'i yum sngon mo// gri thod 'dzin pa 'khril sbyor tshul// yab kyi ral pa spyi bor bcings// yum gyi lcang lo rgyab tu bsnyil// yab yum gnas gsum 'khor pad rdor// dkar dmar mthing gsum yi ge gsum// dkar dmar mthing 'od 'bar bas mtshan// de ltar gsal btab mchaud cing bstod// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis| |gsol ba phur tshugs 'di skad gdab// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ de skad gsol ba btab pa'i mod// bla ma yab yum snyoms zhugs pas// mkha' gsang gnas nas 'od dkar bab// rang gi dpral bar thim ma thag /tha mal zhen pa kun dag nas// dga' ba'i ye shes rtogs par byas// slar yang mkha' gsang 'od dmar bab// rang mgrin thim pas tha mal gyi// chags pa'i bde ba kun sbyangs nas// mchog dga'i ye shes rtogs par byas// slar yang mkha' gsang 'od mthing bab// rang gi snying thim 'dzin zhen gyi// sgrib sbyangs dga' bral rtogs par byas// slar yang mkha' gsang 'od sna tshogs// bab pa rang gi gnas gsum thim// 'dzag bde'i chags pa kun sbyangs nas// lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par byas// slar yang gsol ba btab pa'i tshe// bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug gi| |bde bas 'od zhu bdud rtsi dngos// rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te// spyi bo nas ni rkang mthil yan// ba spu'i khung bu tshun chad gang*// bde stong gnyis med mngon sum du// rtogs par bsams la 'bad par bya'o// thun dang po'o// lam gyi dngos gzhi 'di lta ste// rdo rje rin chen padma dang*// rgya gram 'khor lo yis bteg pa'i// rin chen khri dang pad zla nyi'i| |gdan la hūm̐ dmar las byung ba'i// rdo rje dmar po hūm̐ gis mtshan// de las 'od 'phros 'gro sgrib sbyangs// 'phags mchod thugs rje bsdus la thim// sa bon phyag mtshan yongs gyur las// rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje ni// dmar po zhi 'dzum khro chags nyams// dbu skra ral pa spyi bor bcings// nor bu rdo rje zla bas spras// rin chen rus pa dar gyis brgyan// g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis bsgyings shing*// phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// 'khyud pa'i pang du rang 'dra'i yum// stong nyid rdo rje ma dmar mo| |ral pa bsnyil zhing rus pa dang*// rin chen dar gyis rab brgyan pa// zhabs g.yas yab kyi sked la 'khril// g.yon pa yab g.yas lhan cig brkyangs// g.yas pas gri gug rab gdengs shing*// g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob// yab yum bde ba'i nyams ldan pa'i// dpral bar 'khor lo'i lte ba ru// sku yi rdo rje sku mdog dkar// mgrin par padma'i lte ba ru// gsung gi rdo rje sku mdog dmar// thugs kar rdo rje sngon po yi// lte bar thugs rdor sku mdog mthing*// sku yi rdo rje yab yum gyi// phyag g.yas 'khor lo gsung rdo rje// yab yum g.yas pa padma dang*// thugs kyi rdo rje yab yum gyi// g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs// yab gsum g.yon pa dril bu la// yum gsum g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin// gzhan yang gtso bo yab yum gyi// mig tu gzugs kyi rdo rje dang*// rdo rje gzugs ma sku mdog dkar// rna bar sgra yi rdo rje dang*// rdo rje sgra ma sku mdog mthing*// sna ru dri yi rdo rje dang*// rdo rje dri ma sku mdog ser// kha la ro yi rdo rje dang*// rdo rje ro ma sku mdog dmar// tshigs kun reg bya rdo rje dang*// rdo rje reg ma sku mdog ljang*// yab rnams g.yas g.yon rdor dril la// yum rnams g.yas pa rang rtags kyi// 'dod yon lnga 'dzin g.yon pa rnams// dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba 'dzin// rgyan chas gtso bo yab yum mtshungs// rdo rje gsum dang rdo rje lnga'i| |lha rnams kyi ni gnas gsum du// 'khor lo dkar dang padma dmar// rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba ru// dkar dmar mthing kha'i oṃ āḥhūm̐// gsum gyis mtshan las 'od 'phros pas| |rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs bstim// slar yang 'od kyis rgyal ba rnams// dbang lha'i rnam par spyan drangs mchod// gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur zhing*// sgrib sbyangs chu lhag gyen 'khyil las// gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang ni// gsung gi rdo rje yab yum dang*// ro yi rdo rje yab yum la// 'od dpag med pas rgyas gdab cing*// sku yi rdo rje yab yum dang*// gzugs kyi rdo rje yab yum la// rnam par snang mdzad rigs rgyas gdab// thugs kyi rdo rje yab yum dang*// sgra yi rdo rje yab yum la// mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan cing*// dri yi rdo rje yab yum la// rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan bcings// reg bya'i rdo rje yab yum la// don yod grub pas rgyas btab nas// dbang lha rang bstim lhar gsal ba// rnam gsal rnam dag dran pa dang*// nga rgyal brtan pa'i ngang nyid las// ci gnas yun ring gsal snang 'don// thun gnyis pa'o// de nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni// gtso 'khor bcas pa thams cad kyi// dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po'i dbus// oṃ dkar mgrin par pad dmar steng*// āḥdamar thugs kar rdo rje ni// sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing kha// 'od zer 'bar ba gsal bsgoms nas// srog dang rtsol ba'i rlung gnyis po// nang du 'jug pa oṃ zhes bya// gnas pa āḥyi rang bzhin te// phyir dbyung ba ni hūm̐ yin no// de ltar 'jug gnas dbyung gsum po// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin can// rdo rje'i bzlas pa ces su brjod// 'di nyid ma yeng bzla ba yang*// lus ni lha sku sgyu ma ste// ngag bcad rdo rje'i bzlas pa nyid// sems ni gsal stong phyag rgya che// de lta'i tshul las bgyi ba yang*// 'jug gnas dbyung gsung gcig rtsis pa'i// brgya phrag re la thun re bya// de ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o| |thun gsum pa'o// slar yang spro zhing bsdu ba ni// sa bon rnams las yi ge gsum// grangs med phyogs bcur 'phros pa las// stong gsum 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*// nang bcud bde ba'i rdo rje dngos// 'jug gnas 'gro ba rdor bzlas te// thams cad 'khyer so gsum dang ldan// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i sgra// thams cad rdor bzlas sngags su bsam| |sngags kyi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing*// 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa rab spros pas// srid rtse'i gnas nas mnar med yan// sngags kyi 'od zer gyis gang ste// 'ja' tshon 'khrugs pa lta bur bsam// des ni gang la phog pa yis// 'gro drug sems can thams cad rnams// sgrib sbyangs lha yi go 'phang thob// bde ldan sdug bsngal bral bar bsam// slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer gyis// rgyal ba kun mchod de rnams kyi// mkhyen brtse'i byin rlabs thams cad dang*// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dang*// 'byung ba lnga yi bcud la sogs// phun tshogs thams cad bsdus pa nyid// rang gi gnas gsum yi ger thim// thim ma thag tu rang nyid ni// bde ba'i rdo rje gzi brjid 'bar// nyi ma 'bum yang zil gnon pa'i// brjid ldan 'od du 'bar bar bsgom// thun bzhi pa'o// de nas bsdu ba'i rim pa ni// rang gi gnas gsum yi ge las// 'od 'phros phyi rol snod rnams ni// bcud kyi 'gro ba la thim zhing*// de rnams rang gi sku la thim// gzugs sogs drug po gnas so sor// thim zhing stong nyid rdo rje ma// yab thim yab kyang stod smad nas// 'od zhu gnas gsum lha la thim// gnas gsum sku ni gsung la thim// gsung ni thugs la thugs rdo rje// stod smad 'od zhu rdo rjer thim// rdo rje hūm̐ thim hūm̐ yig kyang*// zhabs kyu khog pa mgo zla tshes// thig le nā da'i bar du bsdu// nā da 'od zer 'bar ba la// dar cig sems gtad slar de nyid// dmigs med ngang du mnyam par bzhag

/bsngo bas rgyas gdab spyod lam 'jug |thun lnga pa'o// de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho 'di// ratna shrī'i gsung bzhin du// chad dang lhag pa'i skyon med par// chos kyis grags pas bris pa'i dges// 'gro kun bde ba'i sa thob shog// /maṅga laṃ//
